mapper.update: update todo_instance set status=#{toStatus},owner_id=coalesce(#{ownerId},owner_id),version=version+1,update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where todo_id=#{todoId} and status=#{fromStatus}
mapper.select: select * from todo_template_version where template_id=#{templateId} and version_no=#{versionNo}
mapper.update: update todo_template set current_version=#{versionNo},update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where template_id=#{templateId} and current_version < #{versionNo}
mapper.select: select r.*,t.template_name,v.owner_rule_json,v.dod_rule_json,v.sla_rule_json,v.next_rule_json from todo_trigger_rule r join todo_template t on t.template_id=r.template_id join todo_template_version v on v.version_id=r.template_version_id where r.event_type=#{eventType} and r.business_type=#{businessType} and r.enabled='Y' and t.status='0'

select s.todo_id,least(999,floor(timestampdiff(second,s.start_at,#{now})/greatest(1,timestampdiff(second,s.start_at,s.due_at))*100)) percent from todo_sla_record s join todo_instance t on t.todo_id=s.todo_id where s.status='RUNNING' and t.status not in ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')
mapper.update: update todo_sla_record s join todo_instance t on t.todo_id=s.todo_id s.remind80_at=#{now},t.sla_status='REMINDED's.overdue100_at=#{now},t.sla_status='OVERDUE's.escalate150_at=#{now},t.sla_status='ESCALATED' where s.todo_id=#{todoId} and s.remind80_at is nulland s.overdue100_at is nulland s.escalate150_at is null
update todo_sla_record set paused_at=#{now},status='PAUSED',version=version+1 where todo_id=#{todoId} and status='RUNNING'

update todo_sla_record set paused_seconds=paused_seconds+timestampdiff(second,paused_at,#{now}),due_at=date_add(due_at,interval timestampdiff(second,paused_at,#{now}) second),paused_at=null,status='RUNNING',version=version+1 where todo_id=#{todoId} and status='PAUSED'
